purpose: UI1: generated per-composition/cell engine parity and confidence evidence for preview labels
generator_method: identical to the derived LT3 run_parity(): screen.Assembler(dump); screen.grid_dims(1920x1080, pitch, padding=12); one_rule.place_rule vs rea_rule.place_rule with ('V5', 0, None, 'equal'); cell (col,row,w,h) deltas; pixel view via screen.cell_px on the 2560x1440 content rect

method.pixel_note: a 1-cell delta is 82 px, so the 1.5 px pixel test equals the integer-cell test

label_note: the label counts cover the 412 Large parity compositions (17 measured + 330 computed + 65 unverified = 412); the 18th measured composition (InjuryHistoryCardGridComposition, no -Large suffix) is outside the 412 Large parity table and also receives 'measured'
